description: This file defines and exports a function `getProjectName` that fetches the display name of a project given its projectId by making an API call to a backend route. It imports an API client from a base module and handles the API response to normalize output.

methods.name: getProjectName(projectId)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a project's display name using its projectId by making a GET request to the backend API endpoint. It handles missing projectId and normalizes the response shape.
